notes:
Redesigned toolbar icons and unified mesh export options.

### New
- Mesh export options for STL, OBJ and 3MF: the same Density slider and detailed controls as the Mesh panel, with a summary of converted objects and triangles before writing. Existing meshes are exported unchanged.

### Improved
- Clearer export dialog: grouped options, only the settings relevant to the chosen format, remembered values.
- Twenty toolbar icons redrawn so that every command is easy to tell apart.
- DXF is always written at 1:1 in model coordinates.
- Exporting a whole model with curves to a mesh format skips the curves instead of failing.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
